subject: CYCLE-1 FINDING ticket04: current wake TOCTOU remains lineage-free; stale mirror-session completion mutates after terminal
body: Current main 7127c287 restores strict app-side generation checks at wake entry and immediately before Shizuku wake, fixing the broader Beta2 stale-admission regression. Remaining source-confirmed gap: WAKE_INNER_DISPLAY carries no service/generation/attempt/connection lineage and shell directly powers the resolved inner physical display, so a request that passes the final app check can still mutate after an intervening NATIVE_COVER transition. This is a bounded non-cancellable in-flight TOCTOU, not field-causal proof. Separately, ensureMirrorSession commits a returned mirrorSession after checking only destroyed + connectionEpoch; it does not re-check controller generation/state or mirrorRequested, so terminal NATIVE_COVER does not make that stale completion an exact no-op. Gen4 cover-route mutations are materially stronger: serviceEpoch + monotonic intentSequence plus shellRevision/token acceptance fencing; no evidence found that an older reassert can become final authority after a newer terminal release. Smallest candidate: give privileged wake monotonic request lineage enforced shell-side before physical power mutation; fence mirror-session completion by generation/visual demand and release stale sessions. Physical Fold7 validation remains required.
